purpose: Machine-checked client/public-contract classification. It does not promote transition routes into public compatibility promises.

classifications.pre-v1-transition: Suite-owned unversioned route usable by current first-party code but not a stable public-v1 promise.
classifications.first-party-private: First-party support/cache/session/helper surface that external clients must not treat as a public contract.
classifications.bounded-domain-plane: Accepted Suite-owned domain plane whose current browser surface is not automatically part of public /api/v1.

publicV1Resources.semantics: public API discovery and compatibility metadata
public API capability and compatibility policy discovery
actor-filtered Backend discovery collection with backendId keyset pagination and provider-neutral representation
idempotent preconditioned native Timer CREATE admission for an existing assignment
explicit-source federated Channel collection with keyset pagination and partial-source metadata
global permission-protected Human Account collection with accountId keyset pagination and secret-free representation

browserClientGroups.note: Legacy/native Timer browser semantics are not equivalent to public TimerAssignment resources.
The public Channel collection is explicit-source/federated and is not a drop-in replacement for the browser channel route; move mutation has no public-v1 equivalent.
Normalized Teletext/HbbTV browser contracts remain a bounded Broadcast Companion plane, not an implicit public-v1 contract.
Public /api/v1/capabilities describes the public API contract; it is not the VDR/backend capability report.

Public /api/v1/backends provides minimal actor-filtered discovery (backendId/name/enabled/online). The bundled browser still consumes richer pre-v1 selection/snapshot semantics, so its wrappers are not migrated by route substitution.
ProgramEvent/EPG public resource semantics are not yet stabilized.
Current global search is a first-party transition route, not a public-v1 search contract.
Cache/refresh helpers are first-party implementation support and must not be frozen as public API.
Metadata and people reads remain pre-v1 until stable resource identity and representation are defined.
Recording collection/action contracts are not yet public-v1.
Cache/folder/trailer helpers are first-party support surfaces and are not public compatibility promises.
There is no /api/v1/search-timers resource; retained aliases remain pre-v1.
Preview-cache refresh is first-party cache maintenance, not a public client contract.
Genre extension routes remain pre-v1 metadata/browse helpers.
Remote action, Live overlay and browser SSE are first-party control/presentation surfaces, not public-v1 promises.

browserOnlySurfaces.note: Browser-session login/CSRF lifecycle is a web-client security surface, not the generic app authentication contract.

derivedNextRuntimeCandidate.reason: Phase 69 closed with eight stable public-v1 method/resource contracts and exact accepted reference-client coverage. Post-Phase-69 additive contracts must preserve that baseline, keep exact current reference coverage, and must not reopen Phase 69. Phase 70 remains independent.

publicClientReferences.note: Transport-injected reference client for already-stable discovery contracts; no browser-private routes and no package/publication claim.
Read-only federated Channel collection extension with explicit 1–16 backend sources, keyset pagination and unchanged partial-source metadata.
Single-backend Suite-owned TimerAssignment keyset collection; no collection ETag, no backend I/O and no native Timer fallback.
Revisioned backend-scoped TimerAssignment item GET with opaque ETag exposure and caller-supplied If-None-Match; no If-Match or mutation.
Caller-owned If-Match + Idempotency-Key protected Timer CREATE admission; exactly one POST returning Operation identity/Location/ETag with no automatic retry or polling.
Actor-owned durable Operation item GET with opaque ETag exposure and caller-supplied If-None-Match; explicit one-shot reconciliation read with no polling or mutation helper.
Read-only global Human Account collection using accounts.view@*; accountId/actorId/displayName/active only, with no credential, session, grant or mutation surface.
